ModMetaData.name: Nivarian Race: MotherShip
ModMetaData.author: 尹怨怨
ModMetaData.description: Nivarian mothership expansion for RimWorld 1.6. Includes 19 tactical supports, a Continuum campaign, a shared points shop, carrier and gravity ship, and optional Milira starship battery upgrades. Precision ally recognition unlocks through research. Languages: 简体中文 / English / Русский / 日本語 / Français.
